role: three registered research tests; none changes fondo-v2 or fondo-v3, a supported result can only motivate a new registered policy version
inspection_before_registration: file layouts and first/last dates only; no returns, anchors or portfolio paths computed

L1_equity_anchor_long_horizon.question: Does the engine's earnings-yield index anchor forecast annualized total returns over 5 and 10 years better than the expanding historical mean?
L1_equity_anchor_long_horizon.forecast: 0.06 + 0.6 * (E(t-3)/P(t) + CPI(t-1)/CPI(t-13) - 1 - 0.06), the same dated inputs as docs/estudio-anclas-valoracion-v1.json
L1_equity_anchor_long_horizon.realized: annualized total return over h years from monthly price and dividends
L1_equity_anchor_long_horizon.benchmark: expanding mean of annualized h-year returns that matured by the origin, from 1871
L1_equity_anchor_long_horizon.overlap_handling: no p-value from overlapping windows; R2_OS is also computed on the h nonoverlapping subsamples starting in 1900, 1901, ..., 1900 + h - 1

verdict_rule.supported: full-sample R2_OS > 0 and R2_OS > 0 in at least 80% of the nonoverlapping subsamples

descriptive_only: the same rule with 1/CAPE instead of trailing earnings

L2_bond_duration_from_carry.question: Does the term spread forecast the 12-month return of the 10-year Treasury in excess of 3-month bills better than its expanding historical mean?
L2_bond_duration_from_carry.data: data/history/valuation/shiller-monthly.csv.gz (GS10) and data/history/macro/TB3MS (monthly 3-month bill, first of month)
L2_bond_duration_from_carry.realized: 12-month return of a 10-year par bond bought at t and valued at GS10(t+12) as a 9-year bond, minus TB3MS(t)/100
L2_bond_duration_from_carry.benchmark: expanding mean of realized excess returns that matured by the origin, from 1935
L2_bond_duration_from_carry.metric: R2_OS with one-sided Clark-West on nonoverlapping origins

L3_international_history.question: Descriptive: how did fondo-v2's mix behave with its international half included, compared with the same mix all in US equity?
L3_international_history.data: data/history/factors/developed-ex-us-monthly and emerging-monthly (French, USD, Mkt-RF + RF), ff5-daily compounded to months for US equity, month-end DGS10 for bonds by duration approximation

mixes.fondo-v2: US 42%, international 28% (75% developed ex-US + 25% emerging), 10-year Treasury 25%, cash 5% at zero yield

L3_international_history.rebalancing: 5 pp drift threshold checked at each month end
L3_international_history.period: 1990-07 to 2018-12; extension to the last common month reported separately
report: maximum drawdown and months to recover
L3_international_history.acceptance: descriptive; a maximum drawdown of fondo-v2 worse than US-only by more than 5 points is flagged in the fund documentation
